text: The Geometry of Decision-Making in DAOs states that calling DAO token voting decentralized governance is a misnomer because most DAOs exhibit extreme centralization in token allocation. This independently corresponds to Kaal's claim that most current DAOs do not deliver their promised decentralized power. The proposition does not measure organizational communication or identify every cause of centralization.
